# Component CMakeLists.txt for the main ESP-IDF component.
# Configures Embedded Swift compilation via the idf_swift component.

if(WIN32)
    set(devnull NUL)
else()
    set(devnull /dev/null)
endif()

idf_component_register(
    SRCS ${devnull}
    PRIV_INCLUDE_DIRS "."
    PRIV_REQUIRES idf_swift
)

idf_component_register_swift(
    ${COMPONENT_LIB}
    BRIDGING_HEADER ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/BridgingHeader.h
    SRCS main.swift
)

# Remove compiler flags that are not supported by the Swift compiler.
get_target_property(_swift_flags ${COMPONENT_LIB} COMPILE_OPTIONS)
if(_swift_flags)
    list(FILTER _swift_flags EXCLUDE REGEX "gdwarf|ggdb")
    set_target_properties(${COMPONENT_LIB} PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "${_swift_flags}")
endif()
